habitat: Open woodland, scrub, forest edge, secondary growth, mangroves, plantations, parks and gardens, rice paddies; sea level to 2000 m
description: Small cuckoo, male grey-brown above and orange below with a grey head, throat and upper breast (female often in a rufous, heavily barred "hepatic" morph); brood parasite of small warblers, prinias, cisticolas and tailorbirds; persistent mournful whistled call.
